title: '[Symptom] '

assignees: ''
---

**What is the symptom? (required)**
A short description of the observable dysfunction.

---

The following sections are optional but help the community contribute richer content.

**What does it look like in practice?**
Describe behaviors, conversations, or patterns teams exhibit when this symptom is present.

**Why is it a problem?**
What impact does this have on delivery, quality, or team health?

**How might teams address it?**
Any known practices, patterns, or approaches that help resolve this dysfunction.

**Relevant links or references**
Any supporting material, articles, or examples.
